rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an upright pole fixed in the ground.

example.english: That post isn't planted deep enough and keeps wobbling.
example.traditional: 嗰支柱插得唔夠深，成日搖嚟搖去。
example.jyutping: go2 zi1 cyu5 caap3 dak1 m4 gau3 sam1 sing4 jat6 jiu4 lai4 jiu4 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for sending a letter or parcel through the postal service.

example.english: I’ll post a letter to you tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 gei3 fung1 seon3 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for a message published on a forum, blog, or other online platform.

example.english: I left a comment under the post on the forum.
example.traditional: 我喺論壇嗰篇帖文下面留言。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 leon4 taan4 go2 pin1 tip3 man4 haa6 min6 lau4 jin4

rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose verb for putting up a notice or posting content online; for sense 11 it means physically attaching a notice, and for sense 27 it means posting a message or image.

example.english: Remember to post the notice at the entrance.
example.traditional: 你記得將張通告貼喺門口。
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 dak1 zoeng1 zoeng1 tung1 gou3 tip3 hai2 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use this for putting content online, especially when emphasizing making it available on the internet rather than the act of posting in a forum.

example.english: We’ll post the event photos online tonight.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚會將活動相片放上網。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 wui5 zoeng1 wut6 dung6 soeng2 pin2 fong3 soeng6 mong5

rows.note: Use this for the postal organisation or the mail service rather than an individual delivery.

example.english: The post service now charges more to send parcels.
example.traditional: 郵政而家寄包裹要加價。
example.jyutping: jau4 zing3 ji4 gaa1 gei3 baau1 gwo2 jiu3 gaa1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when an organization or person announces information or results publicly.

example.english: The organizers will post the competition results next week.
example.traditional: 大會下星期公布比賽結果。
example.jyutping: daai6 wui6 haa6 sing1 kei4 gung1 bou3 bei2 coi3 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this for an appointed job or position in an organisation.

example.traditional: 呢個職位要識講流利英文。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zik1 wai2 jiu3 sik1 gong2 lau4 lei6 jing1 man4
